name: Suzhou Alton Electrical & Mechanical Industry Co., Ltd.
summary: Suzhou Alton Electrical & Mechanical Industry Co., Ltd. engages in the research, development, production and sales of aerodynamic equipment and cleaning equipment in China and internationally. The company offers small air compressors, motors, pneumatic tools, wet and dry vacuum cleaners, household floor scrubbers, industrial fans, vacuum cleaner accessories, small household appliances, smart cleaning appliances, and garden tools lithium battery lawn mower. It is also involved in the design, development, production, and assembly of various electromechanical products.
